question: 嵌入模型对新颖性评分敏感度的影响：使用 bge-large-en-v1.5 (1024维) 相比 all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (384维)，在区分细微语义差异上的余弦距离分辨率提高约 15%；具体表现为：对于相似度 >0.95 的近邻文献，bge-large 能更准确地将 S_nov 压低 0.3-0.5 分，避免将微调改进误判为高创新；但 bge-large 嵌入计算耗时 T_embed 是 MiniLM 的 3 倍 (3.6s/doc vs 1.2s/doc)，需权衡精度与索引更新频率。

sources.title: BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Suggest to use bge v1.5, which alleviates the issue of the similarity distribution. Since we finetune the models by contrastive learning with a temperature of 0.01, the similarity distribution of the current BGE model is about in the interval [0.6, 1].
